tools.name: read
tools.description: Read the contents of a file. Supports text files and images (jpg, png, gif, webp, bmp). Images are sent as attachments. For text files, output is truncated to 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). Use offset/limit for large files. When you need the full file, continue with offset until complete.

path.description: Path to the file to read (relative or absolute)

offset.description: Line number to start reading from (1-indexed)

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to read

tools.name: bash
tools.description: Execute a bash command in the current working directory. Returns stdout and stderr. Output is truncated to last 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). If truncated, full output is saved to a temp file. Optionally provide a timeout in seconds.

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds (optional, no default timeout)

tools.name: edit
tools.description: Edit a single file using exact text replacement. Every edits[].oldText must match a unique, non-overlapping region of the original file. If two changes affect the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead of emitting overlapping edits. Do not include large unchanged regions just to connect distant changes.

path.description: Path to the file to edit (relative or absolute)

oldText.description: Exact text for one targeted replacement. It must be unique in the original file and must not overlap with any other edits[].oldText in the same call.

newText.description: Replacement text for this targeted edit.

edits.description: One or more targeted replacements. Each edit is matched against the original file, not incrementally. Do not include overlapping or nested edits. If two changes touch the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead.

tools.name: write
tools.description: Write content to a file. Creates the file if it doesn't exist, overwrites if it does. Automatically creates parent directories.

path.description: Path to the file to write (relative or absolute)

content.description: Content to write to the file

tools.name: grep
tools.description: Search file contents for a pattern. Returns matching lines with file paths and line numbers. Respects .gitignore. Output is truncated to 100 matches or 50KB (whichever is hit first). Long lines are truncated to 500 chars.

path.description: Directory or file to search (default: current directory)

glob.description: Filter files by glob pattern, e.g. '*.ts' or '**/*.spec.ts'

literal.description: Treat pattern as literal string instead of regex (default: false)

context.description: Number of lines to show before and after each match (default: 0)

limit.description: Maximum number of matches to return (default: 100)

tools.name: find
tools.description: Search for files by glob pattern. Returns matching file paths relative to the search directory. Respects .gitignore. Output is truncated to 1000 results or 50KB (whichever is hit first).

pattern.description: Glob pattern to match files, e.g. '*.ts', '**/*.json', or 'src/**/*.spec.ts'

path.description: Directory to search in (default: current directory)

tools.name: ls
tools.description: List directory contents. Returns entries sorted alphabetically, with '/' suffix for directories. Includes dotfiles. Output is truncated to 500 entries or 50KB (whichever is hit first).

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return (default: 500)

tools.name: powershell
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command in the current working directory. Returns stdout and stderr. Output is truncated to last 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). If truncated, full output is saved to a temp file. Optionally provide a timeout in seconds.

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds (optional, no default timeout)

tools.name: tool_search
tools.description:
# Tool discovery

Searches over deferred tool metadata with BM25 and exposes matching tools for the next model call.

Some of the tools, such as tools of MCP servers, may not have been provided to you upfront, and you should use this tool (`tool_search`) to search for the required tools. For MCP tool discovery, always use `tool_search`.

limit.description: Maximum number of tools to return. Defaults to 8.

tools.name: memory_search
tools.description: Search relevant Global and current Project knowledge. History is opt-in; unavailable sources are reported.

tools.name: memory_get
tools.description: Read one visible memory, optionally with scoped revision history and Session/Entry references.

tools.name: memory_save
tools.description: Save useful descriptive knowledge, not rules. Project decisions depend on their source branch; general experience survives rollback. Label unverified ideas hypothesis.

tools.name: memory_revise
tools.description: Append a correction or supplement with evidence and baseRevision. confirm=true explicitly establishes a new current basis, including for withdrawn knowledge.

tools.name: memory_retire
tools.description: Withdraw outdated knowledge with a reason, preserving evidence and revision history.

tools.name: diagnostic_search
tools.description: Search observed execution metrics across Sessions in the current project, including historical branches. No transcript is injected automatically.

tools.name: diagnostic_get
tools.description: Read one visible Trace, with paginated native Turn, Tool, compaction and retry metrics and precise Session/Entry references.

tools.name: diagnostic_evidence
tools.description: Read a protected, paginated native Session Entry in the current project. Existing Memory sources work without a Trace. Nested calls have bounded summaries, not full result bodies.

tools.name: suggestion_submit
tools.description: Save a capability improvement idea with evidence, expected value and uncertainty for user discussion.
